title: The app catalog is easier to explore
summary:
App discovery and video-model metadata got more useful, while provider routing, health checks, and generated docs got less misleading.

The catalog now opens on all genres and lets people search app names, descriptions, and GitHub fields. Search, genre, and sort settings stay in the URL as you change them. Two community image-generation apps, REKTY GENERATOR and ArtScape Studio, also joined the catalog.

Model-list responses and the SDK ModelInfo type now expose video duration bounds and defaults. Clients can discover which lengths models such as Veo, Wan, Nova Reel, and Seedance support instead of keeping their own list. This adds metadata; it does not change duration validation.

Catalog models can now have per-user, per-model request-per-minute limits across text, image, audio, 3D, embeddings, and realtime requests. Model lists expose configured limits, and requests above one receive a 429 with Retry-After. Models without a configured limit remain uncapped.

daily.title: Search the app catalog
daily.text: Find community apps by name, description, or GitHub field. Search, genre, and sort choices stay in the URL, so you can share the view you found. [Explore apps](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Discover video duration options
daily.text: Model-list responses now include available video duration bounds and defaults, and SDK ModelInfo exposes the same metadata. Check a model’s options before choosing a length. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
